source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 17 (PDF 4-16), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Group 2 Elements) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Why are Group 2 elements called alkaline earth metals?
(Group 2 elements ko alkaline earth metals kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 elements s block metals hain. Inhein un ki metallic fitrat aur zameen ki crust mein maujoodgi ki wajah se alkaline earth metals kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: They are also called the alkaline earth metals due to their metallic nature

blocks.prompt:
2 Where do Group 2 metals stand in reactivity compared with alkali metals and transition metals?
(Reactivity mein Group 2 metals alkali metals aur transition metals ke muqable mein kahan hain?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 metals ki reactivity bohat reactive alkali metals (Group 1) aur kam reactive transition metals ke darmiyan hai.

book_ref.quote: having reactivity between highly reactive alkali metals and less reactive transition metals

blocks.prompt:
3 Why do all Group 2 elements show similar chemical properties?
(Tamam Group 2 elements ki chemical properties milti julti kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tamam Group 2 elements ke bahari s subshell mein do electrons (ns²) hain: Be [He] 2s², Mg [Ne] 3s² waghera. Aik jaisi valence configuration ki wajah se chemical properties milti julti hain.

book_ref.quote: therefore, they exhibit similar chemical properties

blocks.prompt:
4 Give one use each of beryllium and magnesium mentioned in the introduction of the chapter.
(Chapter ke ta'aruf mein bataya gaya beryllium aur magnesium ka aik aik istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Beryllium aerospace materials ke liye copper alloys ko sakht banane mein istemal hota hai. Magnesium chlorophyll (paudon ka sabz maadda) ka aham hissa hai.

book_ref.quote: Mg is an important part of chlorophyll, the green matter in plants

blocks.prompt:
5 Why do the melting points and densities of Group 2 metals not change regularly down the group?
(Group 2 metals ke melting points aur densities group mein neeche ba-qaida kyun nahi badalte?)
blocks.explanation: Melting point aur density ke trends group mein metal atoms ki mukhtalif packing (tarteeb) se mutaliq hain. Misaal: Mg 650 °C par pighalta hai magar Ca 842 °C par, aur Ca (1.54 g/cm³) Mg (1.74 g/cm³) se halka hai.

book_ref.quote: The trend in melting point and density are related to the different packing of the metal atoms down the group

blocks.prompt:
6 Using Table 17.1, state how the ionic radius of M²⁺ and the first ionization energy change from Be to Ba.
(Table 17.1 se batayein ke Be se Ba tak M²⁺ ka ionic radius aur pehli ionization energy kaise badalte hain.)
blocks.explanation: M²⁺ ka ionic radius barhta hai: 31, 65, 99, 113, 135 (Be se Ba). Pehli ionization energy kam hoti hai: 900, 738, 590, 550, 503. Bare atoms bahari electrons ko kam mazbooti se pakarte hain.

book_ref.quote: Table 17.1 Properties of Group 2 (Be–Ba)

blocks.prompt:
7 Using Table 17.1, find the total energy (first + second ionization energy) needed to form Ca²⁺ and Ba²⁺. Which is formed more easily?
(Table 17.1 se Ca²⁺ aur Ba²⁺ banane ki kul energy (pehli + doosri ionization energy) maloom karein. Kaun aasaani se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ca: 590 + 1145 = 1735; Ba: 503 + 965 = 1468 (table ki values). Ba ko kam energy chahiye, is liye Ba²⁺ aasaani se banta hai aur Ba zyada reactive hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 17.1 Properties of Group 2 (Be–Ba)

blocks.prompt:
8 How does the standard electrode potential (E°) change down Group 2, and what does this show?
(Group 2 mein neeche standard electrode potential (E°) kaise badalta hai aur is se kya zahir hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: E° Be se Ba tak zyada negative hota hai (Ca −2.87, Sr −2.89, Ba −2.91 V). Zyada negative E° ka matlab metal aasaani se electrons khota hai, jo group mein neeche barhti reactivity ke mutabiq hai.

book_ref.quote: E° becoming more negative from Be to Ba, is unchanged

blocks.prompt:
9 Why do Group 2 elements react quickly with other substances?
(Group 2 elements doosre substances se jaldi reaction kyun karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ke bahari subshell mein do electrons (ns²) hain. Yeh do electrons kho kar stable M²⁺ ions ban jate hain, is liye doosre substances se jaldi reaction karte hain.

book_ref.quote: After losing these two electrons, they become stable ions with a +2 charge (M²⁺)

blocks.prompt:
10 Give three reasons why reactivity increases from Be to Ba.
(Be se Ba tak reactivity barhne ki teen wajoohat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Group mein neeche: (i) atomic size barhta hai, (ii) shielding effect barhta hai, (iii) ionization energy kam hoti hai. Is se electrons nikalna aasaan hota hai aur reactivity barhti hai: Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba.

book_ref.quote: The reactivity increases from Be to Ba due to the increase in size, shielding effect and decrease in the ionization energy down the group

blocks.prompt:
11 Why is beryllium less reactive towards oxygen than other Group 2 metals?
(Beryllium oxygen ke saath doosre Group 2 metals se kam reactive kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Beryllium sirf zyada temperature (600 °C se upar) par oxygen se BeO banata hai: 2Be(s) + O₂(g) → 2BeO(s). Aik patli magar mazboot oxide layer usay bachati hai, is liye yeh kam reactive hai.

book_ref.quote: A thin, strong oxide layer usually protects it

blocks.prompt:
12 Compare the burning of magnesium and calcium in oxygen.
(Magnesium aur calcium ke oxygen mein jalne ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Magnesium hawa ya oxygen mein chamak kar jalta hai aur MgO banata hai. Calcium zyada tezi se reaction kar ke brick red (eent jaisa surkh) shoala deta hai aur CaO banata hai. Aam equation: 2M + O₂ → 2MO.

book_ref.quote: The reaction of calcium (Ca) with oxygen is more vigorous to give a brick red flame

blocks.prompt:
13 Why are the oxides of Group 2 elements basic? Give the ionic equation.
(Group 2 elements ke oxides basic kyun hain? Ionic equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Paani mein oxide ion paani se reaction kar ke hydroxide ions banata hai jo mahlool ko basic banate hain:
O²⁻(s) + H₂O(l) → 2OH⁻(aq)
Oxides ka basic character group mein neeche barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: due to the reaction between the oxide ion and water to produce the OH⁻ ion

blocks.prompt:
14 What happens when beryllium is heated with steam? Give reason.
(Beryllium ko steam ke saath garam karein to kya hota hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Kuch nahi hota: beryllium garam karne par bhi paani ya steam se reaction nahi karta. Is ki wajah us ki hifazati oxide layer hai.

book_ref.quote: Beryllium (Be) does not react with water or steam, even when heated

blocks.prompt:
15 Write the equations for the reaction of magnesium with cold water and with steam. Which is faster?
(Magnesium ke thande paani aur steam ke saath reactions ki equations likhein. Kaun sa tez hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Thanda paani (bohat aahista): Mg(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Mg(OH)₂ + H₂(g)
Steam (tez): Mg(s) + H₂O(g) → MgO(s) + H₂(g)
Steam wala reaction tez hai.

book_ref.quote: With steam, it reacts faster to form magnesium oxide (MgO) and hydrogen

blocks.prompt:
16 Why does a white precipitate form when calcium reacts with cold water?
(Calcium ke thande paani se reaction mein safaid precipitate kyun banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ca thande paani se tez reaction karta hai: Ca(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Ca(OH)₂ + H₂(g). Calcium hydroxide bohat kam hal hota hai, is liye na-hal hissa safaid precipitate (tah-nasheen) ki shakal mein nazar aata hai.

book_ref.quote: The calcium hydroxide is sparingly soluble, forming a white precipitate

blocks.prompt:
17 Write a balanced equation for the reaction of strontium with water.
(Strontium ke paani se reaction ki balanced equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Doosre Group 2 metals (Be ke ilawa) ki tarah strontium paani se hydroxide aur hydrogen gas banata hai:
Sr(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Sr(OH)₂(aq) + H₂(g)

book_ref.quote: Except beryllium (Be), other Group 2 metals react with water to produce metal hydroxides

blocks.prompt:
18 Why does the basic character of Group 2 hydroxides increase down the group?
(Group 2 hydroxides ka basic character group mein neeche kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 hydroxides ki solubility neeche barhti hai. Zyada hal hone wala hydroxide paani mein zyada OH⁻ ions deta hai, is liye Mg(OH)₂ se Ba(OH)₂ tak basic character barhta hai. (Phir bhi yeh Group 1 se kam basic hain.)

book_ref.quote: the basic character of the hydroxides of Group 2 elements increases down the group due to the increasing solubility

blocks.prompt:
19 Write the general equation for the reaction of a Group 2 metal with dilute HCl. How does reactivity change down the group?
(Group 2 metal ke dilute HCl se reaction ki aam equation likhein. Group mein neeche reactivity kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
M(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)
Namak (salt) aur hydrogen gas banti hai. Reactivity neeche barhti hai: Be (oxide layer se aahista) < Mg (aasaani se) < Ca (tezi se).

book_ref.quote: Group 2 metals react with dilute acids to produce a salt and hydrogen gas

blocks.prompt:
20 Why does the reaction of calcium with dilute sulphuric acid stop early?
(Calcium ka dilute sulphuric acid se reaction jaldi kyun ruk jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Ca(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → CaSO₄(s) + H₂(g)
Banne wala calcium sulphate kam hal hota hai; yeh metal ki satah par hifazati teh bana deta hai aur acid metal tak nahi pahunch pata.

book_ref.quote: the reaction can stop early because the calcium sulphate (CaSO₄) formed is sparingly soluble

blocks.prompt:
21 Write equations for the reaction of magnesium with dilute hydrochloric acid and dilute sulphuric acid.
(Magnesium ke dilute hydrochloric acid aur dilute sulphuric acid ke saath reactions ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mg(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)
Mg(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → MgSO₄(aq) + H₂(g)
Dono mein magnesium ka namak aur hydrogen gas banti hai.

book_ref.quote: Magnesium (Mg) reacts readily with dilute acids

blocks.prompt:
22 Calculate the moles of hydrogen gas formed when 0.25 mol of calcium reacts completely with excess dilute HCl.
(0.25 mol calcium excess dilute HCl se poori tarah reaction kare to hydrogen gas ke kitne moles banenge?)
blocks.explanation:
Ca(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)
1 mol Ca se 1 mol H₂, is liye 0.25 mol Ca se 0.25 mol H₂ banegi (aur 0.50 mol HCl kharch hoga).

book_ref.quote: Calcium (Ca) reacts vigorously with dilute acids to form calcium salts and hydrogen gas

blocks.prompt:
23 Differentiate between Group 1 and Group 2 metals with respect to valence electrons, ions formed and reactivity.
(Valence electrons, banne wale ions aur reactivity ke lehaaz se Group 1 aur Group 2 metals mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono groups mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Group 1 metals have only one electron to lose, making them extremely eager to react and form a +1 ion

rows: Usi period mein kam reactive (zyada ionization energies)

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between Group 1 and Group 2 metals with respect to hardness, density and melting points.
(Sakhti, density aur melting points ke lehaaz se Group 1 aur Group 2 metals mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Physical properties mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Very soft (can be cut with a knife).

rows: Bohat naram (chaaqu se kat jate hain)

blocks.prompt:
25 Differentiate between the oxides and hydroxides of Group 1 and Group 2 metals.
(Group 1 aur Group 2 metals ke oxides aur hydroxides mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Oxides aur hydroxides mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Form MO (e.g., CaO); less basic than Group 1 oxides.

rows: Oxides MO (jaise CaO), Group 1 se kam basic
Hydroxides bohat hal hone wale, taqatwar bases
Hydroxides kam hal (neeche solubility barhti hai), kam basic

blocks.prompt:
26 Compare the reaction of Group 1 and Group 2 metals with water, with one example each.
(Group 1 aur Group 2 metals ke paani se reaction ka muqabla karein, har aik ki misaal ke saath.)
blocks.explanation: Paani se un ke reactions mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Very vigorous, often explosive (e.g., Na with water).

rows: Misaal: Ca aur paani, Mg aur steam

blocks.prompt:
27 What trend in reactivity is common to Group 1 and Group 2? Give its reason.
(Group 1 aur Group 2 mein reactivity ka kaun sa trend mushtarik hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono groups mein neeche jaate hue reactivity barhti hai, kyun ke atomic size barhta aur ionization energy kam hoti hai, is liye valence electrons nikalna aasaan hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Both groups show increasing reactivity going down their respective groups

blocks.text: 17.4 Thermal Decomposition of Carbonates and Nitrates

blocks.prompt:
28 Define thermal decomposition. Why is it usually endothermic?
(Thermal decomposition ki definition likhein. Yeh aam tor par endothermic kyun hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermal decomposition (hararati tehleel) woh reaction hai jis mein aik compound garam hone par do ya zyada saada substances mein toot jata hai. Compound ke andar bonds todne ke liye energy chahiye, is liye yeh aam tor par endothermic hai.

book_ref.quote: Thermal decomposition is a chemical reaction, where a single compound breaks down

blocks.prompt:
29 Write the equations for the thermal decomposition of MgCO₃ and SrCO₃.
(MgCO₃ aur SrCO₃ ki thermal decomposition ki equations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Group 2 carbonates metal oxide aur carbon dioxide dete hain:
MgCO₃(s) → MgO(s) + CO₂(g)
SrCO₃(s) → SrO(s) + CO₂(g)

book_ref.quote: Group 2 carbonates decompose upon heating to form a metal oxide (MO) and carbon dioxide gas

blocks.prompt:
30 What is meant by the polarizing power of a cation? Which Group 2 ion has the greatest polarizing power?
(Cation ki polarizing power se kya muraad hai? Kis Group 2 ion ki polarizing power sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polarizing power cation ki woh salahiyat hai jis se woh qareebi bare anion (jaise CO₃²⁻) ke electron cloud ko bigaarta hai. Chhote aur zyada charge wale cations ki polarizing power zyada hoti hai, is liye Be²⁺ ki sab se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: Smaller and highly charged cations (like Be²⁺) have a greater

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Be²⁺ chhota hai magar charge +2 hai, is liye us ka charge aik chhoti jagah mein jama hai. Yeh qareeb aane wale CO₃²⁻ ke electrons ko apni taraf kheench kar ion ko tedha (distort) kar deta hai, aur C–O bond kamzor ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
31 Why does BeCO₃ decompose at a much lower temperature than BaCO₃?
(BeCO₃ BaCO₃ se bohat kam temperature par kyun toot jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Be²⁺ chhota aur zyada charge wala hai, is ki polarizing power zyada hai. Yeh CO₃²⁻ ko zyada bigaar kar us ke bonds kamzor karta hai, is liye BeCO₃ 250 °C par toot jata hai. Ba²⁺ bara aur kam polarizing power wala hai, is liye BaCO₃ ko 1360 °C chahiye.

book_ref.quote: They distort the large carbonate ion (CO₃²⁻) to a larger extent, weakening its bonds

blocks.prompt:
32 Using Table 17.3, find the difference between the decomposition temperatures of SrCO₃ and MgCO₃. What does it show?
(Table 17.3 se SrCO₃ aur MgCO₃ ke decomposition temperatures ka farq maloom karein. Is se kya zahir hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1289 °C − 540 °C = 749 °C. SrCO₃ ko MgCO₃ se kahin zyada temperature chahiye, is se zahir hai ke carbonates ki thermal stability group mein neeche barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Table 17.3 Temperatures of decomposition of the Group 2 carbonates at 1 atm

blocks.prompt:
33 Write a balanced equation for the thermal decomposition of magnesium nitrate.
(Magnesium nitrate ki thermal decomposition ki balanced equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Group 2 nitrates metal oxide, bhoori NO₂ gas aur oxygen dete hain:
2Mg(NO₃)₂(s) → 2MgO(s) + 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g)

book_ref.quote: brown nitrogen dioxide gas (NO₂), and oxygen gas (O₂)

blocks.prompt:
34 Arrange the Group 2 nitrates in order of increasing thermal stability and give the reason.
(Group 2 nitrates ko barhti thermal stability ki tarteeb mein likhein aur wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Be(NO₃)₂ < Mg(NO₃)₂ < Ca(NO₃)₂ < Sr(NO₃)₂ < Ba(NO₃)₂.
Upar wale chhote M²⁺ ions NO₃⁻ ko zyada bigaarte hain, is liye woh nitrates kam temperature par toot jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Be(NO₃)₂ is the least stable, and Ba(NO₃)₂ is the most stable among them

blocks.prompt:
35 How is the thermal decomposition of Group 2 carbonates and nitrates useful to chemists?
(Group 2 carbonates aur nitrates ki thermal decomposition chemists ke liye kaise mufeed hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 carbonate ya nitrate ke tootne ka temperature dekh kar chemists na-maloom compounds pehchaan aur khaas elements ki tasdeeq kar sakte hain. Yeh pattern ionic size, charge density aur thermal stability ka taalluq bhi dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: chemists can identify the unknown compounds and confirm the presence of specific elements

blocks.prompt:
36 Define enthalpy of hydration. How does it change down Group 2?
(Enthalpy of hydration ki definition likhein. Group 2 mein neeche yeh kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Enthalpy of hydration (ΔHhyd) woh energy hai jo gas wale ions ke paani ke molecules mein ghirne par kharij hoti hai. Yeh hamesha exothermic hai. Group mein neeche ions bare hote hain aur paani ko kam kheenchte hain, is liye yeh kam negative hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: is the energy released when gaseous ions are surrounded and attracted by water molecules

blocks.prompt:
37 Define lattice enthalpy. On what factors does it depend?
(Lattice enthalpy ki definition likhein. Yeh kin cheezon par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lattice enthalpy (ΔHlattice) woh energy hai jo aik mole solid ionic compound ko gas ions mein todne ke liye chahiye; yeh hamesha endothermic hai. Yeh ions ke charge aur size par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: is the energy required to break apart one mole of a solid ionic compound into its gaseous ions

blocks.prompt:
38 How do the relative sizes of the cation and anion affect lattice energy?
(Cation aur anion ke size ka farq lattice energy par kya asar dalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab cation aur anion ke size milte julte hon to kashish mazboot aur lattice energy zyada hoti hai. Jab aik ion bara aur doosra bohat chhota ho to kashish kamzor aur lattice energy kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: When one of the ions is larger and the other much smaller, the forces become weaker

blocks.prompt:
39 What is enthalpy of solution? What value of it favours solubility?
(Enthalpy of solution kya hai? Is ki kaun si value solubility ke haq mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Enthalpy of solution (ΔHsoln) solid ionic substance ke hal hone par kul energy tabdeeli hai. Zyada negative ya kam positive ΔHsoln aam tor par zyada solubility ke haq mein hai.

book_ref.quote: is the overall energy change when a solid ionic substance is dissolved

blocks.prompt:
40 Why does the solubility of Group 2 sulphates decrease down the group?
(Group 2 sulphates ki solubility group mein neeche kyun kam hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neeche ΔHhyd (M²⁺ ki) aur ΔHlattice dono kam hoti hain. Sulphate ion bara hai, is liye hydration enthalpy ki kami lattice enthalpy ki kami se zyada hai; ΔHsoln kam mufeed hoti hai aur solubility ghatti hai (MgSO₄ hal, BaSO₄ na-hal).

book_ref.quote: for a large anion like sulphate, the decrease in hydration enthalpy is more significant

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Bara SO₄²⁻ hone ki wajah se cation chhota ho ya bara, lattice energy zyada nahi badalti. Lekin cation ki hydration energy bare cation ke saath kaafi kam ho jati hai. Is liye neeche jaate hue hal hone ke liye milne wali energy kam padti hai.

blocks.prompt:
41 Using Table 17.4, compare the solubilities of Ca(OH)₂ and CaSO₄ at 298 K.
(Table 17.4 se 298 K par Ca(OH)₂ aur CaSO₄ ki solubility ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ca(OH)₂: 1.5 × 10⁻³ mol/100 g paani; CaSO₄: 4.66 × 10⁻³ mol/100 g paani. CaSO₄ Ca(OH)₂ se taqreeban 3.1 guna zyada hal hota hai (4.66 × 10⁻³ ÷ 1.5 × 10⁻³ ≈ 3.1).

book_ref.quote: Table 17.4 Solubility of Group 2 hydroxides and sulphates

blocks.prompt:
42 Using Table 17.4 (Ca(OH)₂ = 74 g mol⁻¹), calculate the mass of Ca(OH)₂ that dissolves in 100 g of water at 298 K.
(Table 17.4 se (Ca(OH)₂ = 74 g mol⁻¹) 298 K par 100 g paani mein hal hone wale Ca(OH)₂ ka mass maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Solubility = 1.5 × 10⁻³ mol fi 100 g paani.
Mass = 1.5 × 10⁻³ mol × 74 g mol⁻¹ = 0.111 g ≈ 0.11 g, 100 g paani mein.

book_ref.quote: Table 17.4 Solubility of Group 2 hydroxides and sulphates

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between the solubility trends of Group 2 hydroxides and Group 2 sulphates.
(Group 2 hydroxides aur Group 2 sulphates ke solubility trends mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono trends ulte hain:

book_ref.quote: Table 17.4 Solubility of Group 2 hydroxides and sulphates

rows: Mg(OH)₂ bohat kam hal (2 × 10⁻⁵ mol/100 g)
Lattice enthalpy hydration se zyada kam hoti hai
Hydration enthalpy lattice se zyada kam hoti hai

blocks.prompt:
44 Why is the hydration enthalpy of Mg²⁺ more negative than that of Ba²⁺?
(Mg²⁺ ki hydration enthalpy Ba²⁺ se zyada negative kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mg²⁺ (ionic radius 65) Ba²⁺ (135) se bohat chhota hai aur us ki charge density zyada hai. Chhote, zyada charge density wale ions paani ko zyada kheenchte hain, is liye zyada energy kharij hoti hai (zyada negative ΔHhyd).

book_ref.quote: Smaller ions with higher charge density attract water molecules more strongly

blocks.prompt:
45 Define a complex ion. Name the roles of the central metal ion and the electron donors in it.
(Complex ion ki definition likhein. Is mein markazi metal ion aur electron donors ka kya kirdaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Complex ion woh ion hai jis mein markazi metal aas paas ke kai electron dene wale species se bonded ho. Markazi metal ion Lewis acid (electron pair lene wala) hai; lone pairs wale donors (H₂O, NH₃, Cl⁻, OH⁻) Lewis bases hain.

book_ref.quote: A complex ion is an ion in which a central metal is bonded to a number of surrounding electron donating species

blocks.prompt:
46 What is coordination number? Give the coordination numbers of Be²⁺ and Mg²⁺ in their hydrated ions.
(Coordination number kya hai? Be²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ke hydrated ions mein coordination numbers likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Coordination number markazi metal ion aur electron donors ke darmiyan coordinate bonds ki tadaad hai. Be²⁺ [Be(H₂O)₄]²⁺ (coordination number 4) aur Mg²⁺ [Mg(H₂O)₆]²⁺ (coordination number 6) banata hai.

book_ref.quote: is called coordination number

blocks.prompt:
47 Why is complex formation more typical of transition metals than of Group 2 metals?
(Complex banana Group 2 ke muqable mein transition metals mein zyada aam kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Transition metals ke paas bonding ke liye d-orbitals dastiyab hain, is liye un mein complex banana aam hai. Group 2 ions (khaas tor par upar wale) bhi complex banate hain magar yeh rujhan kahin kam hai.

book_ref.quote: Their tendency to form complexes is far less pronounced than that of transition metals

blocks.prompt:
48 Why are hydrated Group 2 metal ions regarded as complex ions?
(Hydrated Group 2 metal ions ko complex ions kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Group 2 salts paani mein hal hon to metal ions hydrate ho jate hain. Paani ke molecules markazi M²⁺ ion ko electron pairs dete hain, is liye hydrated ions (jaise [Be(H₂O)₄]²⁺, [Mg(H₂O)₆]²⁺) asal mein complex ions hain.

book_ref.quote: These are essentially complex ions where water molecules act as electron pair donors

blocks.prompt:
49 Why does beryllium form a hydrated ion with coordination number 4 while magnesium forms one with coordination number 6?
(Beryllium coordination number 4 wala aur magnesium coordination number 6 wala hydrated ion kyun banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Be²⁺ sab se chhota Group 2 ion hai aur us ki charge density zyada hai; yeh paani ko zor se kheenchta hai aur coordination number 4 wala hydrated ion [Be(H₂O)₄]²⁺ banata hai. Mg²⁺ bara hai aur aam tor par hexahydrate [Mg(H₂O)₆]²⁺ banata hai.

book_ref.quote: forms a hydrated ion with a coordination number of 4

blocks.prompt:
50 How does EDTA form a complex with calcium ions? Give the equation.
(EDTA calcium ions ke saath complex kaise banata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
EDTA chhe electron pairs dene wala donor hai; yeh aik hi Ca²⁺ ion se kai coordinate bonds bana kar ring structure banata hai:
Ca²⁺(aq) + EDTA⁴⁻(aq) → [Ca(EDTA)]²⁻(aq)

book_ref.quote: Calcium ion forms a complex ring structure with a six electron pair donor, EDTA

blocks.prompt:
51 Give two uses of the complex formation of Group 2 ions with EDTA.
(Group 2 ions ke EDTA ke saath complex banne ke do istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Paani naram karna: EDTA sakht paani se Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ions nikalta hai. (ii) Dawai: EDTA (Ca-EDTA complex) jism se zehreele metal ions, kabhi zaid Ca²⁺ bhi, nikalne mein istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This complex formation is used in water softening

blocks.prompt:
52 What is the role of calcium hydroxide in the Dow process?
(Dow process mein calcium hydroxide ka kya kirdaar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Calcium hydroxide (limestone ya seepiyon se hasil) samandar ke paani mein daala jata hai; yeh Mg²⁺ ions ko na-hal magnesium hydroxide ki shakal mein precipitate karta hai jise phir filter kar liya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: which precipitates magnesium as insoluble magnesium hydroxide

blocks.prompt:
53 How is magnesium hydroxide converted into magnesium chloride in the Dow process? Write the equation.
(Dow process mein magnesium hydroxide ko magnesium chloride mein kaise badla jata hai? Equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Filter kiye gaye Mg(OH)₂ ko hydrochloric acid se reaction karaya jata hai:
Mg(OH)₂(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + 2H₂O(l)
Phir MgCl₂ ka mahlool garha aur khushk kiya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Magnesium hydroxide is filtered and then reacted with hydrochloric acid (HCl)

blocks.prompt:
54 Write the overall reaction of the electrolysis step of the Dow process and name the product at each electrode.
(Dow process ke electrolysis wale qadam ka kul reaction likhein aur har electrode ka product batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pighle MgCl₂ ki electrolysis:
Mg²⁺(l) + 2Cl⁻(l) → Mg(l) + Cl₂(g)
Cathode par khalis magnesium metal aur anode par chlorine gas banti hai.

book_ref.quote: produces pure magnesium metal at the cathode and chlorine gas at the anode

blocks.prompt:
55 Why is the Dow process considered an ingenious industrial process?
(Dow process ko aik zaheen (kamaal ka) sanati process kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh qeemti metal magnesium ko aik wafir magar kam concentration wale zariye (samandar ka paani) se bohat bari sanati miqdaar mein nikalta hai. Is ne magnesium ki paidawar mein inqilaab la diya.

book_ref.quote: from an abundant, low-concentration source (sea water) on a massive industrial scale

blocks.prompt:
56 Calculate the mass of magnesium obtained by electrolysis of 285 g of molten MgCl₂ (Mg = 24, Cl = 35.5 g mol⁻¹).
(285 g pighle MgCl₂ ki electrolysis se kitna magnesium milega? (Mg = 24, Cl = 35.5 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation:
M(MgCl₂) = 24 + 2(35.5) = 95 g mol⁻¹; moles = 285/95 = 3.0 mol.
MgCl₂ → Mg + Cl₂, is liye 3.0 mol Mg = 3.0 × 24 = 72 g magnesium.

book_ref.quote: The molten MgCl₂ is subjected to electrolysis in large electrolytic cells

blocks.prompt:
57 What is calcination? Write the equation for the production of quicklime.
(Calcination kya hai? Quicklime banane ki equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Calcination limestone ki thermal decomposition hai jis mein usay lime kiln mein bohat zyada temperature (aam tor par 900-1000 °C) par garam kiya jata hai:
CaCO₃(s) → CaO(s) + CO₂(g) (garmi)

book_ref.quote: in a process called calcination or thermal decomposition

blocks.prompt:
58 Why is carbon dioxide removed continuously from a lime kiln?
(Lime kiln se carbon dioxide musalsal kyun nikali jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Band bartan mein CaCO₃ ka tootna reversible hai. CO₂ musalsal nikaalne se equilibrium daayen taraf jata hai aur zyada CaO jaldi banta hai.

book_ref.quote: The reaction is reversible in the closed container

blocks.prompt:
59 Calculate the mass of quicklime obtained by heating 2.5 kg of pure limestone (CaCO₃ = 100 g mol⁻¹, CaO = 56 g mol⁻¹).
(2.5 kg khalis limestone garam karne se kitna quicklime milega? (CaCO₃ = 100, CaO = 56 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation:
CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂; CaCO₃ ke moles = 2500 g / 100 g mol⁻¹ = 25 mol.
CaO ka mass = 25 × 56 = 1400 g = 1.4 kg.

book_ref.quote: Quicklime, or calcium oxide, is a vital chemical used in construction (cement, mortar)

blocks.text: 17.8 Uses of Group 2 Elements and Compounds

blocks.prompt:
60 Differentiate between quicklime and slaked lime.
(Quicklime aur slaked lime mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono calcium compounds mein farq yeh hai:

book_ref.quote: Calcium oxide (CaO, quicklime) and calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)₂, slaked lime) is used in making cement, mortar, and plaster

rows: Limestone garam kar ke banta hai (calcination)
Cement, mortar, plaster; steel mein milawat nikalta hai
Cement, mortar, plaster; tezaabi zameen mein daala jata hai

blocks.prompt:
61 Write the formulae of gypsum and plaster of Paris and give one use of gypsum.
(Gypsum aur plaster of Paris ke formulas likhein aur gypsum ka aik istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Gypsum: CaSO₄·2H₂O; plaster of Paris: CaSO₄·½H₂O. Gypsum se plasterboard (drywall) aur plaster of Paris banaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Calcium sulphate (CaSO₄·2H₂O, gypsum) is used to make plasterboard (drywall)

blocks.prompt:
62 How do calcium compounds help to prevent acid rain?
(Calcium compounds acid rain (tezaabi baarish) rokne mein kaise madad karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: CaO aur CaCO₃ flue gas desulphurization (wet scrubbing) mein istemal hote hain. Basic hone ki wajah se yeh bijli gharon ke dhuen se tezaabi SO₂ nikal dete hain aur acid rain rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: to remove acidic sulphur dioxide (SO₂) from power plant emission

blocks.prompt:
63 Why is magnesium oxide used for lining furnaces?
(Magnesium oxide bhattiyon ki andarooni teh ke liye kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Magnesium oxide ka melting point bohat zyada hai, is liye yeh refractory material (bhatti ki teh) ke taur par istemal hota hai jo bohat zyada temperature bardasht karta hai.

book_ref.quote: is used as a refractory material (lining furnaces) due to its high melting point

blocks.prompt:
64 Give one use each of magnesium metal, strontium compounds and beryllium from the chapter.
(Chapter se magnesium metal, strontium compounds aur beryllium ka aik aik istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Magnesium: halke alloys (aerospace, gaariyan), fireworks aur flares (chamak kar jalna). Strontium compounds: fireworks aur flares mein surkh rang. Beryllium: mazbooti ke liye alloys (springs, aerospace) aur X-ray tubes (X-rays ke liye shaffaf).

book_ref.quote: used in lightweight alloys (e.g., aerospace, automotive), fireworks, and flares

blocks.prompt:
65 Why is Milk of Magnesia safe to use as an antacid?
(Milk of Magnesia antacid ke taur par istemal karna mehfooz kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Milk of Magnesia Mg(OH)₂ hai. Yeh maiday ka zaid tezaab khatam karta hai (aur halka julaab hai), aur is ki kam solubility isay mehfooz banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Its low solubility makes it safe to use

blocks.prompt:
66 Name two magnesium compounds used in medicine and state why magnesium is needed by the body.
(Dawai mein istemal hone wale do magnesium compounds ke naam likhein aur batayein ke jism ko magnesium kyun chahiye.)
blocks.explanation: Magnesium sulphate aur magnesium citrate (Epsom salts MgSO₄·7H₂O julaab ke taur par). Magnesium compounds pathon (muscles) aur aasaab (nerves) ke kaam ke liye zaroori hain aur magnesium ki kami ke ilaaj mein istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: are important for muscle and nerve function

blocks.prompt:
67 Why are calcium compounds used as dietary supplements?
(Calcium compounds ghizaai supplements ke taur par kyun istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Calcium compounds (calcium carbonate, calcium citrate waghera) mazboot haddiyon aur daanton ke liye zaroori hain, is liye osteoporosis (haddiyon ki kamzori) se bachao ke liye supplements ke taur par liye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: are essential for strong bones and teeth

blocks.prompt:
68 Why are calcium and magnesium called essential plant nutrients?
(Calcium aur magnesium ko paudon ke zaroori ghizaai ajza kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Calcium cell wall ki tameer ke liye zaroori hai aur magnesium chlorophyll ka markazi atom hai jo photosynthesis (zia-talifi amal) ke liye laazmi hai. Calcium nitrate ya magnesium sulphate (Epsom salts) khaad ke taur par istemal ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: Calcium and magnesium are essential plant nutrients
